properties.value: Vendored go-ethereum ECIES: concatKDF (ANSI X9.63 concatenation KDF) derives the AES and HMAC keys from the ECDH shared secret z at ecies.go:167, feeding the ECIES encrypt/decrypt used for Ethereum message encryption. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 50 sites are imports of Go's crypto/rand (some aliased cryptorand/crypto_rand) — the operating-system CSPRNG, used for key generation (ecdsa.GenerateKey with rand.Reader), wallet seeds (BIP39/BIP32), nonces and salt. Good practice throughout: no math/rand in a security context among these. The Go stdlib CSPRNG is quantum-irrelevant (randomness survives quantum attack); this object documents the RNG posture. Changeable here only in the sense of staying on it.
